description: This file defines the AttendanceProvider class, a Flutter ChangeNotifier that manages attendance data, interacts with attendance repository and realtime service, and provides methods for fetching, updating, and synchronizing attendance records.

classes.name: AttendanceProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages attendance data, listens to real-time updates, and provides functionalities to fetch, mark, and synchronize attendance records.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the provider by connecting to real-time service, listening for attendance stream updates, and fetching today's attendance records. Also starts background sync.

methods.name: fetchToday
methods.description: Fetches today's attendance records from the repository and updates the internal list.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Marks attendance for a student in a classroom with a specific status, then refreshes the list.

methods.name: _backgroundSync
methods.description: Runs an infinite loop that periodically attempts to synchronize pending data every 20 seconds.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cancels stream subscription, disposes the real-time service, and cleans up resources.
